blocks.text: BOGOTÁ, Colombia — Colombia’s leftist former President Gustavo Petro is facing an investigation after a woman accused him of trading sexual favors for government contracts while in office, the Supreme Court chief said Saturday. Petro leads the opposition to President Abelardo de la Espriella and previously served as president from 2022 until August of this year. The case reached the high court after a woman filed a complaint with prosecutors alleging that she and approximately 30 others received government contracts in exchange for having sexual relationships with Petro.
